summary: rcf audit test-strength --structural-only <acIds> judges the structural layer and the unmutated bound tests of the named criteria, each of which must be in --acs, runs no mutant for them, and records each per criterion as blocked with a reason code of its own and a reason naming the flag, while the other criteria are judged by mutation as today; the named criteria's generated mutants count neither in the record nor toward --max-mutants. A structural reason (no Code Node, unbound, no symbol-level Code Node, no mutable symbol, or any reason the structural layer reports) stays a failure; a red or timed-out unmutated bound test of a named criterion exits 2 with the existing lines and records nothing; an id outside --acs, or the flag with no id, is a one-line usage error (exit 2); the help names the flag beside the exit 5 sentence; light Finalise accepts and prints such a record as any recorded blocked. The exit codes AC-20502-5 states hold.
approach: src/cli/test-strength.js: the --structural-only option in the option spec, its ids checked against --acs (an id outside them, or no id, one [error] usage line naming the flag and the id, exit 2, with no help text after it); the option text, the Blocked section and the exit 5 entry of the help. src/audit/test-strength/index.js: a structuralOnly set beside acs; a named criterion is judged structurally and has its mutants generated as today, so its structural and generation reasons (no Code Node, unbound, no symbol-level Code Node, no mutable symbol) stay a failure; one that passes keeps its mutants out of the --max-mutants total and the record and has its bound tests run in the unmutated pass (proved), so a red or timed-out run ends the run with the existing lines; after the unmutated pass it is made blocked (result blocked, blocked true, mutants [], zero in every mutant count, a reason code of its own and a detail naming --structural-only, the bound test files after its id on the BLOCKED and FAIL lines), and the blocked row is returned with that reason rather than TEST_STRENGTH_UNSUPPORTED. src/finalise/light.js is expected to need no change.
deliverables: src/cli/test-strength.js: the --structural-only option, its usage errors, the option text and the exit 5 entry of the help (builder)
src/audit/test-strength/index.js: the named criteria judged structurally and run unmutated, their mutants never run nor counted, and recorded blocked with the flag's reason code (builder)
Code Nodes for every criterion of this spec (builder)
